Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

entry.title: Fabián Cháirez (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a painting by Fabián Cháirez (pictured) depicting a nude, effeminate Emiliano Zapata caused violent protests at the Palacio de Bellas Artes?

entry.title: an American football game (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that an American football game had missiles set up in firing position on the field?

entry.title: The Way We Talk (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Chung Suet Ying has better sign language skills than her character in The Way We Talk, which requires her to sign "worse"?

entry.title: Golden Rondelle Theater (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that while executives believed the Golden Rondelle Theater would be a waste of money, it was one of the 1964 World's Fair's most popular attractions?

entry.title: Sahati Suharto (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that University of Indonesia dean Sahati Suharto was sued by one of her expelled students?

entry.title: a Michigan radio station (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the first general manager of a Michigan radio station almost died of carbon monoxide poisoning during construction?

entry.title: Robin Shahar (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the Attorney General of Georgia argued that Robin Shahar's lesbian wedding meant that she didn't have "good sense"?

entry.title: Aquilegia confusa (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the expansion of glaciers created two distinct forms of Aquilegia confusa, with individual populations better adapted to different elevations?

entry.title: Cleo (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the identity of Cleo, who provided online answers to complex mathematics problems without showing any work, was revealed over a decade later in 2025?
